text: A simple way to make a melody feel finished is to repeat its opening phrase at the end; that return gives listeners a satisfying sense of arrival.
A well-organised home can make shared repairs easier: community repair cafés bring people together to mend household items, passing on practical skills as well as saving useful things.
Turn leftover cooked rice into a quick lunch: stir it in a pan with a splash of water and any spare vegetables until piping hot, using what’s already in the fridge.
